messages:
deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout v4.0.0 -> 10% (regions: global). Initiator: viv. Command: `/deploy start --version v4.0.0 --percent 10 --note \"perf tuning + tokenizer parity\"`

viv: preflight OK. change window 01:00-04:00 UTC. i'll watch latency and error spikes.

harry: QA smoke green. release notes done. watch p99 and 5xx.

alert-bot: NOTICE: na-east increased 5xx-rate to 0.7% (threshold 0.4%). Top error: grpc_timeout_model_host.

cleo: seeing same on dashboards for NA-East. p99 +180ms. traces show retry loops to model-host-3.

viv: hold off further percent bumps. pin NA-East while triage happens. Do we prefer config revert or rollback?

ops-sre: Vote: HOLD and pin. Immediate plan: triage traces and attempt targeted config revert for connection timeouts (retry/backoff tweak). Contingency: full rollback to v3.9.8 if errors persist >3m above threshold. Rollback command noted: `/deploy rollback --version v3.9.8 --percent 100`.

harry: i'll draft a short support blurb: \"Investigating increased 5xx errors in NA-East; engineers are triaging. We'll update in 15m\".

cleo: i'm opening a revert PR to adjust backoff: https://git.redwood/pr/5102. If CI OK, can apply to NA-East only.

ops-sre: Pin command executed: `/release pin v4.0.0 --scope na-east --reason \"5xx spike na-east\" --initiator viv`

deploy-bot: Pin applied. Percent bumps disabled for pinned scope. Thread state: PINNED (na-east).

alert-bot: ALERT: na-east 5xx-rate 0.9% (2m window). Escalate if >1.0% or sustained.

harry: support blurb posted. oncall paged.

cleo: PR CI is green. staging smoke looks stable with backoff tweak. Recommend apply to NA-East.

ops-sre: Approve targeted config apply. Execute `/config apply --path /ops/retry/backoff-na-east.json --scope na-east` and monitor for 5m.

deploy-bot: Config apply recorded by ops-sre. Applying revert to NA-East now.

alert-bot: NOTE: post-apply 5xx trending down, p99 improving. Keep watching for 10m before unpin.

viv: thanks. schedule: re-eval in 10m. If stable, we'll resume rollout to 25% for NA-East. If not, prepare rollback.

ops-sre: Documenting decision: targeted config revert applied; prefer config-first over full rollback during change window. Postmortem owner: viv. Resume action pending 10m stable metrics.
